<script setup lang="ts">
import { RatingGroupRoot as ArkRatingGroupRoot } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import type {
  RatingGroupRootEmits,
  RatingGroupRootProps as ArkRatingGroupRootProps,
} from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { cn } from '@/lib/moduix/cn';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export type RatingGroupSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';

export interface RatingGroupRootProps extends /* @vue-ignore */ ArkRatingGroupRootProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
  size?: RatingGroupSize;
}

export interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ RatingGroupRootEmits {}

const { class: className, size = 'md' } = defineProps<RatingGroupRootProps>();
defineEmits<Emits>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
const rootClass = 'group/rating-group inline-flex flex-col gap-1 text-muted-foreground';
</script>

<template>
  <ArkRatingGroupRoot
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="cn(rootClass, className)"
    :data-size="size"
    data-slot="rating-group-root"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkRatingGroupRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { RatingGroupRootProvider as ArkRatingGroupRootProvider } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import type { RatingGroupRootProviderProps as ArkRatingGroupRootProviderProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { cn } from '@/lib/moduix/cn';
import type { RatingGroupSize } from './RatingGroup.vue';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface RatingGroupRootProviderProps
  extends /* @vue-ignore */ ArkRatingGroupRootProviderProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
  size?: RatingGroupSize;
  value: ArkRatingGroupRootProviderProps['value'];
}

const { class: className, size = 'md', value } = defineProps<RatingGroupRootProviderProps>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
const rootClass = 'group/rating-group inline-flex flex-col gap-1 text-muted-foreground';
</script>

<template>
  <ArkRatingGroupRootProvider
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="cn(rootClass, className)"
    :data-size="size"
    :value="value"
    data-slot="rating-group-root-provider"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkRatingGroupRootProvider>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { RatingGroupLabel as ArkRatingGroupLabel } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import type { RatingGroupLabelProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { cn } from '@/lib/moduix/cn';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ RatingGroupLabelProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
}

const { class: className } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkRatingGroupLabel
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="
      cn(
        'text-sm leading-5 font-semibold text-foreground select-none data-disabled:opacity-50',
        className,
      )
    "
    data-slot="rating-group-label"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkRatingGroupLabel>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { RatingGroupControl as ArkRatingGroupControl } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import type { RatingGroupControlProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { cn } from '@/lib/moduix/cn';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ RatingGroupControlProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
}

const { class: className } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkRatingGroupControl
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="cn('inline-flex items-center gap-1 data-disabled:opacity-50', className)"
    data-slot="rating-group-control"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkRatingGroupControl>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { RatingGroupItem as ArkRatingGroupItem } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import type { RatingGroupItemProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { cn } from '@/lib/moduix/cn';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ RatingGroupItemProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
  index: RatingGroupItemProps['index'];
}

const { class: className, index } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkRatingGroupItem
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="
      cn(
        'inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-sm leading-none text-inherit outline-1 -outline-offset-1 outline-transparent transition-[color,opacity] duration-200 ease-in-out focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-ring data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:cursor-default data-readonly:cursor-default motion-reduce:transition-none',
        className,
      )
    "
    :index="index"
    data-slot="rating-group-item"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkRatingGroupItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { RatingGroupContext as ArkRatingGroupContext } from '@ark-ui/vue/rating-group';
import RatingGroupItem from './RatingGroupItem.vue';
import RatingGroupItemIndicator from './RatingGroupItemIndicator.vue';

defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkRatingGroupContext v-slot="ratingGroup">
    <RatingGroupItem v-for="item in ratingGroup.items" :key="item" :index="item">
      <slot>
        <RatingGroupItemIndicator />
      </slot>
    </RatingGroupItem>
  </ArkRatingGroupContext>
</template>
